sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Invoices"."Order_ID" AS e, "Marketing_Regions"."Marketing_Region_Descriptrion" AS g, SUM("Invoices"."Order_Quantity") AS m1 FROM "Invoices" JOIN "Customer_Orders" ON "Customer_Orders"."Order_ID" = "Invoices"."Order_ID" JOIN "Stores" ON "Stores"."Store_ID" = "Customer_Orders"."Store_ID" JOIN "Marketing_Regions" ON "Marketing_Regions"."Marketing_Region_Code" = "Stores"."Marketing_Region_Code" GROUP BY "Invoices"."Order_ID", "Marketing_Regions"."Marketing_Region_Descriptrion"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of quantity invoiced per Customer_Orders within Marketing_Regions.Marketing_Region_Descriptrion (additive)
share of the all total of total of quantity invoiced (all level)
rank within the group by total of quantity invoiced, keep the top 3
